newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Court rejects Anzoil claim in Vietnam row.
newsitem.headline: Court rejects Anzoil claim in Vietnam row.

text.p: Anzoil NL said on Wednesday that it had lost a legal bid to increase its stake in Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd by more than 4.4672 percent.

The ruling by the Western Australian Supreme Court was the last leg of a battle between Anzoil and Frontier Petroleum NL, its partner in the natural gas production contract in Vietnam's onshore Hanoi basin.
The dispute began in February when Frontier failed to meet a drawdown notice of $852,435 issued by Anzoil (Asia) to fund exploration and appraisal.

Anzoil said in a statement that the court ruled on Wednesday against its claim for rectification of one factor in the dilution formula of the shareholders agreement, which meant its increased stake in Anzoil (Asia) would be no more than 4.4672 percent.
That increase, which would, take Anzoil's share to 84.4672 percent, was guaranteed by a court ruling last month.
Before the dispute, Anzoil NL had owned an 80-percent stake and Frontier 20 percent.
